reporting-org.narrative: Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing

description.narrative:
The 10% Target Programme, launched by the NAB, is designed for Dutch institutitonal investors, incuding Pension Funds, Insurance companies and Banks). The programme encourages these stakeholders to commit to allocating a minimum of 10% of their assets under management to impact investing. In addition to this 10% target, participants are encourageg to set a sub-target of 4% for investing in emerging markets.
As of December 2025, three pension funds and three insurance companies have adopted the 10% target. In addition, several other institutions have set targets ranging between 4% and 8%. Some organisations have also chosen to express their commitments in absolute amounts rather than percentages.

activity-date.narrative: The 10% Target programme was launched post the successful hosting of the Collaborative Lunch in December 2023 where the NAB brought together leaders from both private and public financial institutions and public officials with the aim to inspire all stakeholders to move towards a stronger collaborative and engaging ecosystem. The 10% Target programme remains active as of December 2025 and will continue hosting activities focused towards institutional investors and eventually bring more focus to the 4% sub-target.
